a.text: The leader of men knelt before Kjeragandr and offered Her the highest regard. Thus asked:
'All who live on these lands worship and revere Your Holiness.'
'And so, please tell us, what is our name?'
'I have a name for thee. From this day, these lands shall be called Kjerag, and thou shalt be known as the children of Kjerag.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Sir Arctosz.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: —! I'm here. Your orders, Great Saintess?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No need to be so tense, Sir Arctosz. I don't eat people.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: This is the first time you are participating in the Holy Hunt yourself, Saintess. I am not the only one. Take a look at the warriors around us. With you gracing our presence, we are all tense, eager to put on our best show!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: As the Saintess, I believe participating in the Holy Hunt with the warriors of Kjeragandr my rightful duty.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You make a fine point!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Let's not talk about me. It seems something has been on your mind since the hunt began. If there is anything you would like to ask, please don't hesitate.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Haha... I guess I wasn't going to fool the Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: If you don't mind, you can think of me as a friend.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And I, too, will think of you as a friend.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Great Saintess...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: In my heart, I see you as a friend, Great Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: In that case, let us talk as friends.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Very well. Then, if I may speak my mind.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I want to know your thoughts on the whole transfer of powers affair?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: How straightforward.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: We are friends, after all.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: When it comes to battle, the Paleroches are no less impressive than the Browntails and Silverashes. In subterfuge, though? We're no match for them.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hiding machinations and manipulating others? It's not my style.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You are right...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: However, my friend, you will have to forgive me.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Before I answer your question, I must first make sure of something.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Please, go on.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Sir Arctosz, you are a brave, loyal warrior.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I know you as a frank, straightforward individual, but I also know you nonetheless give your matters due consideration.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You say friends should not hide anything from one another. Let me be honest and get to the point.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: —I would like to know why you have been so staunchly against Enciodes's plans to open up to the outside world?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'm a ruffian, Saintess.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It doesn't matter how much Enciodes boasts about his so-called opening up and how attractive it all is. I don't care about windbaggery and lip service.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: All I care is what he brings.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And I see him bringing waves of unfaithful foreigners gushing into our homes, the destruction of our lands and mountains in the name of expansion, and the children of Kjeragandr losing their faith after working in his territory.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The things he brings to Kjerag are convenient. He rakes in lots of money and has built many big houses on the back of it. I know all that.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But if everyone takes after him and casts aside faith in the name of prosperity, what will become of our lands?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Kjeragandr ordered the Paleroches to protect Kjerag. As such, I, Arctosz, will not allow anyone to bring it to ruin, however they try!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Now I understand how you feel, Sir Arctosz...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: In that case, it's time for me to answer your question too.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Sir Enciodes proposed to turn over all his core lands to me. It was so sudden that it caught me by surprise.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: So you didn't know beforehand?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Indeed, I never expected him to make such a suggestion.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But––

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I don't claim to know understand Sir Enciodes's thought process and how he arrived at the idea of turning all powers over to me. However, if we look at the outcome, I don't think this is a bad turn of events.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: At the Vine-Bead Court, I watch the masses pray to Kjeragandr day in and day out.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: There is one thing that I understand better than Sir Enciodes, and that's the fact that Kjerag has not yet lost its faith.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I suppose, now that this decision has been made, whatever happens from here won't be so easily influenced by any one person.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The unexpected always comes to pass, no?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: If Sir Enciodes hasn't thought of this before, then I must've thought too highly of him.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Fine... whatever the case for everything else, I trust your word on this.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: To tell you the truth, Great Saintess, up until you just spoke, this conversation made me feel as though I had been talking to someone entirely other than the Saintess.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I guess I must be overthinking it.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm saddened to hear how you feel about our conversation.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But I will never deny that Silverash is my name too.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: However, when I became the Saintess, I separated from the secular world. It was the same Sir Enciodes who stripped my name of meaning.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Great Saintess...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: We can't hold the beasts back any longer, huh...?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: All hands, get ready to hunt!

steps.name: Merchant A
steps.text: Saintess portraits, Saintess embroideries, Saintess sculptures!

steps.name: Merchant A
steps.text: The symbol of the Kjerag faith! What are you waiting for? Bring Kjeragandr's blessings home with you!

options: I wonder how things are going with Sharp.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Whoa... that gave me a jump...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Woke you up, huh?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Whoa, your hands are like ice...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: What are you spacing out for? You've been standing there, not moving an inch.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh, did that scare you?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Haha, you seem fine to me!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: What are you looking at? Did you catch the Holy Hunt ceremony? Even the Saintess is joining the hunt this time. Everyone here's been looking forward to it!

options: How did this ceremony come about?
You don't seem all that excited to me.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: From what I heard, the Vine-Bead Court found in the scripts a couple centuries ago that this was the day Kjeragandr first appeared to us, and so they made this Kjerag's biggest festival.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: As for what to do during the Ceremony...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You see how most people are just enjoying the festivities.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The Saintess has one other thing to do, though. She has to cleanse the Tschäggättä loot obtained during the Holy Hunt.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: And the specifics of that process... You'll find out later.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Hmm, has anyone ever told you you're pretty sharp...?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It's true that I get to leave all my work behind at the Court and enjoy the festivities out here.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But I feel bad whenever I think about how much work the Saintess has, none of which I can help with, in any way.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Besides...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh, whatever. It's a festival. Let's not talk about that.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh, you're asking just the right person.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: There's probably not a lot of fun things to do... Aside from the markets, nearly everything has to do with Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: If you want to take this chance to learn more about Kjeragandr, though, there is no better time.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Come, let me show you around~

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: This season every year, the devotees who teach and study at the academy come back to the Vine-Bead Court to preach or to give lessons about Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Let's have a listen.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: A millennium ago, our forebears angered Kjeragandr. She vowed to never again protect Kjerag, and a harsh winter befell our lands.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: Every year, to calm Her fury, the Vine-Bead Court picked the girl with the purest soul to head skyward toward the mountaintop, carrying a bell that represents Her, until the young maiden sacrificed her soul to Her.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: When She heard the cries of the one hundredth girl, Kjeragandr at long last forgave the people of Kjerag, and the cruel winters came to an end.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: That was how Kjerag's first Saintess came to be.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: This again, huh...? Right, I read a different version of this story in the Vine-Bead Court's texts.

a.text: Every year, to calm Kjeragandr's fury, Kjerag chose a girl to be its Saintess, who was to sit atop Mount Karlan and pray until her death.
Kjeragandr is said to have appeared before the masses as a young girl, and so everyone believed that a maiden's pure soul could reach Her and beckon Her back to us.
This ritual continued for almost a hundred years. Over time, the people gradually turned against these unreciprocated rituals.
There was a rebellion against the Vine-Bead Court led by a small clan leader whose daughter was chosen to be the Saintess.

Many of the Vine-Bead Court's buildings were leveled, and many of its texts, kept since ancient times, were destroyed. Ever since, the Vine-Bead Court's understanding of its past has been wildly off the mark.

And the most dramatic thing about this turn of events is that the Saintess still climbed to the top of Mount Karlan that year, and Kjeragandr regained Her strength after a centuries-long slumber. Hearing the prayers of the Saintess, She awakened.
The signs of Her awakening were so obvious that the people immediately noticed. Their resistance against the Vine-Bead Court came to a close, just like that.

options: Sounds like something you saw with your own eyes.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Right? At the same time, it's also a lot more cruel.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: No, no, not at all. I only found the scripture at the Court by chance. It might be a record left behind by someone who was actually there. It could also be nothing more than pure nonsense.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: After all, Kjerag's snowy mounts are known to swallow men whole.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Sir! A large group of beasts has been spotted up ahead!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: These beasts are unusually brutal. They're attacking our soldiers at the front right now!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: They're just beasts! There's nothing to be afraid of!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: All of you, stay here and protect the Saintess. Keep your formation and do not panic. Valais, you stay here too.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Everyone else, come with me. We'll back up our brothers up ahead!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Sir Arctosz, wait!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Great Saintess?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I will come with you.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: But, Great Saintess, your safety...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Valais is right. Your safety is what's important here. Please wait for us here. The Paleroche warriors will protect you!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Wait up, Arctosz!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Ratatos...? What are you doing here? I thought the Browntails and the Silverashes were supposed to take their hunts elsewhere?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The Silverashes have left already, but something doesn't seem right about all this. I was going to come give you a heads up before we split... but it looks like there's no need for that anymore.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What do you mean by that?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You mean the unusual pack of beasts up ahead, Madame Ratatos?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Fine observation, Great Saintess.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I don't know the specifics... but I have a bad feeling about this. I only hope that no one is trying to pull anything funny during an occasion as dignified as the Holy Hunt, let alone putting on a show.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Anyway, we should be more careful. For the first time ever, the Saintess is personally gracing us with her presence during a hunt.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You're exaggerating things, Madame Ratatos.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You do have a point, though. Since I am here, I must stand alongside our brave warriors, instead of cowering in the face of danger.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Please, the situation is urgent. Let us talk on the way.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Well then!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: How fortunate is Kjerag that you feel this way, Great Saintess! I won't stop you! Valais, lead the way!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Why aren't you here yet, Monch?! The Saintess doesn't personally join the Holy Hunt every day! We have to seize the opportunity to take care of as many beasts in front of her as we can!)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (But... what if we hurt the Saintess by accident...?)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Argh, whatever! It's not like that bitch Ratatos would do anything! Worst case, I'll own up to it!)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (You must take this chance, Monch!)

steps.name: Old Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: How can these beasts be so fearless?!

steps.name: Old Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: This definitely isn't normal...

steps.name: Young Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Here I thought the beasts in the mountains would be scared stiff with the Saintess joining us.

steps.name: Young Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Looks like things aren't that simple. Guess the Saintess isn't really all that.

steps.name: Old Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Watch your mouth! The Saintess isn't for you to discuss so nonchalantly!

steps.name: Old Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Think about what will happen if Sir Arctosz catches you complaining!

steps.name: Young Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Fine, fine. I get it! He'd chew me out if he heard...

steps.name: Old Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: As long as you know... Wait, watch out behind—
Get down!
A silver arc of light pierces the raging snowstorm before the beast is able to let out its chilling cry.
With the beast's icy fangs mere inches away, its warm, stinking blood is splattered all over the warrior's face.

Slowly, the Kjerag Saintess sets her hand down from her bowstring as she walks toward the source of the commotion. Just as the texts described, she is accompanied by both Browntail and Paleroche fighters.

a.text: 'She is the Kjeragandr's vicar on Terra. She is Kjeragandr's supreme emissary on the mountaintop.'
Even the snowfall comes to a halt in her presence.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Are you hurt?

steps.name: Young Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: The... The Saintess...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The danger is yet to pass. Stand up, young warrior.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Warriors of Kjeragandr, raise your weapons! Join me in fending off these beasts and completing the challenge posed to us by Kjeragandr!

steps.name: Young Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Young Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: For... For the Saintess!

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: For the Saintess!
